steps: The Horizontal Milling Machine performs finish milling on the Rough Milled Part, machining it for 63 minutes at a milling speed of 1200 RPM using a climb milling tool path with contour following to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm, resulting in the Finished Machined Component, which is then placed on the ConveyorBelt.

On a CNC Turning Center, a precision turning operation is performed on a Lathed Part retrieved from a ConveyorBelt, using CNC program Program_8421 with verified and calibrated tool offsets and a spindle speed of 950 RPM, taking 84 minutes to produce a Finished Machined Component that is then placed on a MobileRobot.

On the Punch Press, a punching operation is performed on a Sheet Metal Blank for 3 minutes, using a 12 mm diameter punch at a stroke speed of 80 strokes per minute with die alignment automatically set via an optical guide, resulting in a CutSheetMetal component labeled as the Finished Sheet Metal Product, which is then transferred to a MobileRobot.

On the Gear Shaper, a broached component is shaped into a spur gear with 24 teeth through the gear shaping operation at a speed of 180 strokes per minute, taking 53 minutes to complete, after which the resulting shaped gear is transferred to the conveyor belt.

On a Broaching Machine, an internal broaching operation is performed on a Metal Bar Stock loaded from a MobileRobot, using a pull-type broach with carbide tips at a feed rate of 0.2 mm per stroke and a depth of cut of 3 mm, producing a Broached Component that is transferred to a ConveyorBelt, taking 1 minutes.

A Wire Electrical Discharge Machining operation is performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) to achieve precision cutting of a Shaped Part, using a 0.25 mm brass wire with electrical parameters set to a peak current of 250 A and a pulse duration of 10 µs at a cutting speed of 4 mm/min, lasting for 35 minutes, resulting in a Precision Finished Part that is transferred to a MobileRobot.

A precision 5-axis milling operation is performed on a Stewart Platform Mills machine for 20 minutes, using an Φ8 mm end mill with coolant through and an active damping system engaged to maintain stability, machining a milled part loaded from a MobileRobot into a ground part with a milling precision of ±0.005 mm, which is then unloaded to a ConveyorBelt.

On the Honing Machine, a cylinder honing operation is performed on a Honed Cylinder taken from the ConveyorBelt, using a 220 grit honing stone to achieve a bore size of 45.0 mm ±0.01 mm, lasting for 43 minutes, resulting in a Precision Finished Part that is placed on the MobileRobot.

The Laser Cutter performs laser cutting on a sheet metal component loaded by a MobileRobot, using a laser power of 4000 W, a cutting speed of 2.5 m/min, and nitrogen gas assist at 18 bar, transforming it into cut sheet metal which is then transferred to a conveyor belt, all for 43 minutes.

A roughing milling operation is performed on a vertical milling machine using a square end mill, 10 mm in diameter, at a milling speed of 1000 RPM and a depth of cut of 5 mm per pass, processing the lathed part from the conveyor belt into a milled part for 85 minutes, which is then transferred to a mobile robot.

The Milled Part is subjected to surface planing on a Planer for 23 minutes, achieving a planing depth of 1.5 mm, a feed rate of 0.3 mm/rev, and a surface finish of Ra 3.2 µm, resulting in a Planed Part that is transferred to the ConveyorBelt.

Using a drill press, a metal bar is drilled with a 10 mm twist drill at a spindle speed of 850 RPM and a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev for 21 minutes, resulting in a drilled component that is placed on a mobile robot.

The bandsaw performs a cutting to length operation on a metal bar stock loaded from a mobile robot, using a bi-metal variable pitch blade at a saw speed of 60 m/min to produce a 50 mm kerf, and outputs the lathed part to a conveyor belt, taking 10 minutes.

On a Hobbing Machine, a gear hobbing operation is performed on a Broached Component to create an involute gear profile with a 20° pressure angle, running at a hobbing speed of 150 RPM and a feed rate of 0.5 mm/rev, lasting for 77 minutes, transforming the component into a Hobbied Gear that is then transferred to a MobileRobot.

On a Horizontal Lathe, a metal bar is subjected to rough turning for 83 minutes, using a carbide insert TNMG 16 04 08 tool at a rotation speed of 750 RPM and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, resulting in a lathed part that is transferred to a conveyor belt.

A planed part is loaded from a conveyor belt onto a grinding machine where it undergoes surface grinding using an aluminum oxide grinding wheel with 60 grit at a wheel speed of 1500 m/min and a feed rate of 0.05 mm per pass, transforming it into a ground part that is then transferred to a mobile robot, all taking place for 27 minutes.

Using a screw machine, automatic screw machining is performed on a lathed part for 35 minutes, producing a screwed component with an M10 metric coarse thread at a production rate of 120 units per hour, after which the output is placed on a conveyor belt.

On a Shear (Sheet Metal) machine, a sheet metal component is sheared into a cut sheet metal piece through a shearing operation lasting 18 minutes, using a hardened steel straight-edge blade with a shear angle of 1.5 degrees and a cutting speed of 2 cuts per minute, after which the resulting sheared sheet metal is placed on a mobile robot.

The Shaper performs a shaping operation on the Milled Part, using a HSS single-point cutting tool with a stroke length of 150 mm and a shaping speed of 30 strokes per minute, transforming it into a Shaped Part, which is then placed on the ConveyorBelt, and the operation takes 44 minutes.

On a Vertical Lathe, a metal bar loaded on a conveyor belt undergoes facing and turning operations for 39 minutes, using a ceramic insert CCMT 12 04 08 tool at a rotation speed of 700 RPM and a feed rate of 0.18 mm/rev, resulting in a lathed part that is transferred to a mobile robot.

On a Vertical Lathe, a MetalBar is turned into a LathedPart using a carbide insert (CNMG 432) tool at a rotation speed of 850 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, with the operation lasting for 97 minutes, after which the finished part is placed on a ConveyorBelt.

A precision milling operation is performed on a horizontal milling machine using a climb milling tool path with contour following at a spindle speed of 1200 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm, processing the MilledPart component from the conveyor belt for 48 minutes, resulting in the finished machined component being placed on the mobile robot.

On a Broaching Machine, an internal broaching operation is performed on a LathedPart using a pull-type spline broach to achieve IT7 tolerance class, taking 63 minutes, after which the resulting BroachedComponent is placed on a ConveyorBelt.

On a Hobbing Machine, gear hobbing is performed on a BroachedComponent loaded from a ConveyorBelt to produce an Involute HobbiedGear with a 20° pressure angle and 32 teeth, operating at a hobbing speed of 60 m/min and a feed rate of 0.5 mm/rev, and the operation runs for 76 minutes, after which the finished HobbiedGear is transferred to a MobileRobot.

The Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) performs wire cutting on the shaped part for 75 minutes, using brass-coated zinc wire (0.25 mm) with a cutting speed of 8 mm/min and electrical parameters of 250 A peak current and 10 µs pulse duration, resulting in a precision-finished ground part that is transferred to the conveyor belt.

The honing machine performs precision honing on a honed cylinder, using a 220 grit stone to achieve a bore size of 45.000 ± 0.003 mm, resulting in a precision-finished ground part, and the operation runs for 36 minutes before the output is placed on a mobile robot.
